quote:
When a nation throws its arrow, the ancient soil remembers the quiet it must take back.

Rumors carried by the wind can become storms if the heart does not hold a still shore.

Even when the ocean swallows a small boat, the stars above continue to guide those who have lost their compass.

A kingdom may soften a ribbon of succession, yet the same cloak still hides the weight of old binding.

When a monkey's laughter echoes across the world, it can reveal more hidden truths than the face that smiles.

Selling the breath of markets for swift profit turns wisdom into a whisper chased by noise.

A bus that meets the ground leaves behind a reminder that safety is the distance between the road and the heart.
quote_preview: When a nation throws its arrow, the ancient soil remembers the quiet it must take back.
